description: Funds from a single source are rapidly split across many receiving accounts to obscure origin.
detection_signal: One sender, unusually high count of distinct receivers in a short window

description: Funds from many distinct senders converge on a single receiving account before further movement.
detection_signal: One receiver, unusually high count of distinct senders in a short window

description: Funds move through a closed loop of accounts and return, in part, to the originator.
detection_signal: Directed cycle detected in the transaction graph (A->B->C->A)

description: Same sender-receiver pair transacts repeatedly at high value, often just under reporting thresholds.
detection_signal: High transaction count and/or value concentrated on one sender-receiver edge

description: Funds are gathered from multiple sources into a hub, then scattered out to a different set of accounts.
detection_signal: Hub node with high in-degree followed shortly by high out-degree

description: Ordinary bilateral payments with no structuring, no repetition anomalies, no cyclic paths.
detection_signal: No anomaly flags raised by chain/cycle/frequency detectors
